item.title: The UAE in Sudan
item.description: This week on Hold Your Fire!, Richard is joined by Crisis Group experts Shewit Woldemichael and Alan Boswell to discuss how the UAE and other foreign powers are sustaining Sudan’s war, deepening the suffering of Sudanese civilians and complicating diplomatic efforts to end the fighting.
item.dc:creator: hschaub

item.title: The View from Eritrea
item.description: This week on The Horn, Alan speaks with Reuters journalist Giulia Paravicini about her recent reporting trip to Eritrea’s capital, Asmara, what she learned about life in the isolated country and its leadership’s calculations amid regional turmoil and mounting tensions with Ethiopia.
item.dc:creator: hschaub
